Subject: A close-up, high-angle shot of a physical color photograph lying on an old wooden desk under the warm, dim glow of a vintage desk lamp.
Photo Content: Inside the photo is Chen Wei, a 23-year-old Asian woman with delicate features, 3D semi-realistic anime style (like Final Fantasy or sophisticated Donghua). She is wearing an elegant evening gown at a luxurious charity gala. She has a polite, frozen smile, but her eyes are lifeless, hollow, resembling dust-covered glass beads, devoid of light or soul.
Environment & Atmosphere: The desk is in a dark room. In the background, a window with rain streaks (visualizing the "tap-tap" sound), blue cold light coming from outside contrasting with the warm lamp light. An old pendulum clock is visible in the shadows.
Style/Tech: Unreal Engine 5 render, C4D, Octane Render, photorealistic textures, depth of field, cinematic lighting, melancholic atmosphere, highly detailed, 8k.
